opportunities.summary: The current Radboud Scholarship Programme page confirms a partial tuition scholarship for non-EEA students: 2026/27 grant holders pay €2,694 instead of approximately €18,000 depending on programme, and the award covers visa, residence-permit, health-insurance and liability-insurance costs. Living and study costs are not covered. The scholarship is available for English-taught Master's programmes except Erasmus Mundus and joint degrees, requires two reference letters and a CV in addition to the admission application, and uses a 31 January scholarship deadline for the September intake. Radboud's current Data Science and AI page lists the September 2027 route opening 1 October 2026, with a scholarship deadline of 31 January 2027 and a general deadline of 1 April 2027. International admission requires a foreign Bachelor's equivalent to a Dutch research-university degree in Computing Science or Artificial Intelligence, at least 12 credits of mathematics, at least 12 credits of theoretical computing including AI/data analysis/ML/data mining/databases, programming and algorithms, and a final project/thesis of at least 10 EC. For Computing Science/Data Science and AI, the current English page lists IELTS 7.0 overall with 6.5 writing and 6.0 in other subscores, TOEFL iBT 100 with 22 subscores or specified new-scale equivalents, Cambridge 185 with 176 subscores, PTE 67 with 61 subscores, or LanguageCert 75 with listed minima. Radboud separately offers limited assistance in finding housing to eligible first-year international Master's students, but cannot guarantee a room and does not state rent on the reviewed page. The award is partial and reference-required, not fully funded or reference-free.

opportunities.summary: The official DEAI consortium pages confirm a two-year, 120-ECTS English-taught Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's in Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence delivered across five European universities. The Full DEAI Scholarship covers 100% of participation costs/insurance and provides EUR1,400/month for up to 24 months; the Partial route covers participation costs without a monthly allowance. The FAQ states accommodation is not included, though local administrative managers help students find housing. Applicants from all countries can apply with a 180-ECTS Bachelor's degree or equivalent and CEFR B2 English, with Computer Science/Mathematics preparation preferred. The current portal requires referees to upload recommendation letters, while the official application manual describes 0–3 references and the admission page scores reference letters; this official conflict is retained for manual review. The current published dates are for the 2026–2028 cohort; 2027–2029 dates are not yet published.

Faculty English thresholds are IELTS 7.0 with no subscore below 6.5, TOEFL iBT 94 with no subscore below 22 for pre-21 January 2026 tests or the new 5/4.5 scale thereafter, or Cambridge 185 with no subscore below 176. Reference letters are optional according to the programme FAQ; core application documents include diploma/transcripts, English certificate, passport, motivation letter, CV and EUR90 fee proof.

opportunities.summary: The current official University of St Andrews Data Science online course and scholarship pages confirm up to six awards each academic year for applicants to the full online MSc Data Science. Each award is worth up to GBP6,000 toward tuition fees only and may last up to three years. For January 2027 entry, the course application deadline is 8 January 2027 and the separate scholarship application deadline is 16 December 2026. The online MSc is a three-year distance-learning route with statistical modelling, machine learning, data visualisation, Python, data-driven systems and end-to-end machine learning. Admission requires a 2:1 equivalent degree or approved professional-learning route, CV, personal statement, academic transcripts/degree certificates and one signed academic reference. The university's postgraduate English table maps Computer Science to Profile 5-D: IELTS 7.0 overall with 6.0 minimum in each component, or listed equivalents. Online postgraduate programmes are exempt from the standard application fee. January 2027 course tuition remains unpublished, and no living or accommodation support is provided by the award.
